info.name: Log Analyzer - Phase 4 (Tools & Agents)
info.description:
Phase 4 Agent testing collection.

PREREQUISITE: Run Phase 3 collection Step 1 (ingestion) first — the agent's tools query the same vector store.

Debugging tips:
- Set breakpoint in LogTools.searchLogs() to see when the LLM decides to call it
- Set breakpoint in LogTools.filterByLevel() to watch level filtering
- Set breakpoint in LogTools.analyzeErrorPatterns() to see pattern grouping
- Watch console logs: OpenAI request/response logs show the full tool-calling conversation (the LLM's reasoning, tool call requests, tool results, and final answer)

item.name: Step 0 — Ingest test data
item.description: Ingest logs so the agent's tools have data to work with. Skip if you already ran Phase 3 ingestion.

item.name: Step 1 — Single-tool queries
item.description:
Each query should trigger ONE tool call. Watch the console to confirm which tool the LLM chose.

DEBUG: Set breakpoints in all 3 LogTools methods. Only ONE should be hit per request.

item.name: 1a. Agent — Search for database errors
item.description:
EXPECTED TOOL CALL: searchLogs("database error", ...)

DEBUG: Set breakpoint in LogTools.searchLogs()
- Inspect 'keyword' parameter — what did the LLM pass?
- Inspect 'limit' — did the LLM choose a reasonable number?
- Step into embeddingStore.findRelevant() to see similarity scores
- Check the returned list — these are what the LLM will reason about

item.name: 1b. Agent — Filter by ERROR level
item.description:
EXPECTED TOOL CALL: filterByLevel("ERROR")

DEBUG: Set breakpoint in LogTools.filterByLevel()
- Watch the semantic search retrieve candidate chunks
- Then watch the regex filter keep only lines with 'ERROR'
- Compare: how many chunks came from the vector store vs how many passed the filter?

item.name: 1c. Agent — Analyze error patterns
item.description:
EXPECTED TOOL CALL: analyzeErrorPatterns()

DEBUG: Set breakpoint in LogTools.analyzeErrorPatterns()
- Watch the regex extract error messages from each chunk
- Inspect the resulting Map<String, Integer> — are errors grouped correctly?
- The LLM will then summarize this map in natural language

item.name: 1d. Agent — Search for timeout issues
item.description:
EXPECTED TOOL CALL: searchLogs("timeout", ...)

Should find the payment-service timeout from batch 0b.

item.name: 1e. Agent — Filter WARN level
item.description:
EXPECTED TOOL CALL: filterByLevel("WARN")

Should return warnings about retries, cache misses, and session expiry.

item.name: Step 2 — Multi-tool queries (Agent reasoning)
item.description:
These complex queries should trigger MULTIPLE tool calls. The agent will:
1. Call one tool, observe results
2. Decide it needs more info, call another tool
3. Synthesize all results into a final answer

DEBUG: Set breakpoints in ALL LogTools methods. Watch the order they're hit.
Also watch the console — the OpenAI logs show the full reasoning chain.

item.name: 2a. Agent — Find errors and suggest fixes
item.description:
EXPECTED: Agent calls searchLogs or analyzeErrorPatterns first, then reasons about fixes.

DEBUG: Watch the console for the multi-step conversation:
- LLM sends a tool_call request
- Tool executes and returns results
- LLM reasons about results and may call another tool
- LLM generates final answer

item.name: 2b. Agent — Compare error types
item.description:
EXPECTED: Agent may call filterByLevel("ERROR") and analyzeErrorPatterns() to compare.

This tests multi-step reasoning — the agent needs data from multiple tools to answer.

item.name: 2c. Agent — Full incident report
item.description:
EXPECTED: Agent calls multiple tools to build a comprehensive report.

This is the most complex query — watch how the agent orchestrates tools.

item.name: Step 3 — Edge cases
item.description: Test how the agent handles unusual inputs.

item.name: 3a. Agent — Unrelated question
item.description:
The agent should call a tool, find nothing relevant, and say so.
Tests: does the agent hallucinate or stay grounded?

item.name: 3b. Agent — Vague question
item.description: A vague question — watch which tool the agent chooses and what arguments it passes.

item.name: 3c. Agent — Empty vector store (restart server first)
item.description:
Restart the server to clear the in-memory store, then run this.
The agent's tools will return empty results. Watch how it handles that.

item.name: Step 4 — Compare Agent vs RAG vs Direct
item.description: Same question through 3 different approaches. Compare the answers.

item.name: 4a. Phase 2 — Direct analysis (no context)
item.description: Direct LLM call with just the log snippet. No retrieval, no tools.

item.name: 4b. Phase 3 — RAG query (retrieval + generation)
item.description:
RAG retrieves relevant chunks and injects them into the prompt.
Compare: richer context than 4a, but you control the question.

item.name: 4c. Phase 4 — Agent (autonomous tool use)
item.description:
The agent DECIDES what to do. It may search, filter, analyze — all autonomously.
Compare: most flexible, but you don't control which tools it picks.
